Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
I am very glad of your favourable answer about the [Cameos](../books.html#240). I shall be glad of the terms you propose - dividing the profits and you taking the risk, my object being to have them continued without expense
I am delighted to see the faithful and affectionate notice in the new number of the Magazine[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The obituary of Alexander Macmillan, sr., who had died on 26 January 1896: ‘Alexander Macmillan’ Macmillan’s Magazine 73 (March 1896) 397-400.
